title: Unmatched Noise Cancelling!
review_text: The noise cancelling on these headphones is unmatched. I travel frequently for work on flights between Toronto and Vancouver, and the engine drone simply vanishes. Sound quality is crisp with deep punchy bass. Best purchase I made this year.

title: Best headphones I have ever owned
review_text: Upgraded from the XM3 and the difference in comfort and microphone quality during Zoom and Teams calls is night and day. The multi-point connection works seamlessly between my MacBook and iPhone.

title: Amazing sound, but headband hurts after 2 hours
review_text: Sound quality and ANC are a solid 10/10. However, the new thinner headband design causes noticeable pressure on the crown of my head after about 2 hours of continuous wear. The XM4 was actually more comfortable.

title: Disappointed by the non-folding design
review_text: Why did Sony remove the folding hinges? The carrying case is massive and takes up half of my backpack. For a $500 CAD pair of travel headphones, portability should be priority #1.

title: Auto ANC is frustrating
review_text: You cannot manually lock ANC to maximum power anymore. Sony's 'Auto NC Optimizer' constantly shifts intensity when you move your head or adjust glasses. It is very distracting in quiet office settings.

title: Pure auditory bliss
review_text: Listening to FLAC files with LDAC enabled on Android is mind-blowing. The clarity of vocals and separation of instruments surpasses Bose QuietComfort Ultra easily. Battery easily lasts 30 hours.

title: Great features, steep Canadian price
review_text: Outstanding product, fast charging gives 3 hours in 3 minutes. But at $549 CAD plus tax, it feels slightly overpriced compared to sales on previous models.

title: Call quality finally fixed!
review_text: Previous Sony headphones had terrible microphones that picked up wind and coffee shop background noise. The 4 beamforming mics and AI noise reduction on the XM5 make calls crystal clear.

title: Defective hinge after 6 months
review_text: The swivel mechanism on the left earcup started creaking and now feels loose. For a premium flagship product, the plastic build feels a bit cheap. Disappointed with durability.

title: Solid upgrade for daily commuters
review_text: Subway rumble on the TTC is practically non-existent with these on. Ambient sound mode is natural and transparent. Highly recommended for daily transit.

title: Good sound, but touch controls are finicky in winter
review_text: When wearing gloves outside in Calgary winter, touch controls don't respond at all. Sometimes light rain or hood friction accidentally triggers pause or skip track.

title: Sublime comfort for all-day coding
review_text: I wear these 8 to 10 hours a day programming. The soft fit leather ear cushions don't make my ears sweat like pleather pads on other brands. Zero clamping fatigue.

title: Software updates broke Bluetooth multipoint
review_text: After the latest firmware update, multipoint connection disconnects randomly every 20 minutes from my Windows PC. Sony support was unhelpful.

title: Better than Bose QC Ultra
review_text: Tried both side-by-side at the BestBuy store. Sony has richer bass, much better companion app EQ controls, and superior battery life. No contest.

title: Average sound out of the box, needs EQ tuning
review_text: Out of the box, the bass is a bit boomy and muddy. Once you tune the Sony Headphones Connect app EQ (excited preset or custom +2 clear bass), it comes to life.

title: Terrible customer service experience
review_text: Headphones arrived with a scuffed ear cup. BestBuy online replacement took 3 weeks to process. Product itself is decent but buying experience was frustrating.

title: Travel essential
review_text: Cuts crying babies on 8 hour transatlantic flights like magic. The speak-to-chat feature is surprisingly handy when the flight attendant asks for drink orders.

title: Overheats ears during summer
review_text: The earcups lack breathability. Walking outside in 28 degree weather in Montreal caused sweat buildup inside the drivers after 30 minutes.

title: Simply the gold standard
review_text: Sony WH-1000XM5 sets the benchmark for wireless noise cancelling. Build is sleek, battery life is phenomenal, and spatial audio with 360 Reality Audio is immersive.

title: Not worth the premium over XM4
review_text: Owned the XM4 for 3 years. XM5 has slightly better mics, but sounds identical and does not fold. Save $150 and buy the XM4 instead.

title: Exceptional battery life
review_text: Charged it on Sunday and used it all work week without plugging it in once. Rapid USB-PD charging is a lifesaver.

title: Microphone mute button is missing
review_text: Why is there no physical mute button for video calls? You have to mute from your computer or phone screen, which is annoying during long meetings.

title: Ear cups started peeling
review_text: Less than 10 months of use and the leatherette seam is coming undone. At this price point genuine leather or replaceable pads should be standard.

title: Impressed by transparency mode
review_text: I can have full conversations without taking off the headphones. The ambient sound level adjusts smoothly.

title: Bluetooth latency while gaming
review_text: Noticeable audio lag when playing competitive shooters on PC via standard Bluetooth. Fine for movies and music, but not for gaming without cable.

title: Super light and stylish
review_text: Love the minimalist matte black aesthetic. They look much more modern and futuristic than previous Sony models.

title: ANC pressure headache
review_text: The active noise cancellation creates an uncomfortable 'cabin pressure' eardrum sensation for me. Had to return them after 3 days.

title: High fidelity sound
review_text: Pairing with LDAC audio player produces magnificent detail in jazz and classical tracks. Treble is smooth without harsh sibilance.

title: Good but expensive
review_text: Great headphones overall. Does everything well, but wait for Black Friday sale if you want real value.

title: Speech detection is overly sensitive
review_text: Speak to chat triggers when I cough or clear my throat, constantly pausing my podcasts. Ended up turning the feature off in app.

title: Silence in a noisy gym
review_text: Blocks out loud gym music, weights clanging, and loud talkers completely. Stays firmly in place on head during bench press and cardio.

title: App requires too many permissions
review_text: The Sony Headphones app demands location tracking and account creation just to adjust equalizer settings. Very invasive privacy policy.

title: Fantastic purchase from BestBuy
review_text: Ordered online, ready for curb-side pickup in 30 minutes. The soundstage is wider than my previous Sennheiser Momentum.

title: Wind noise in outdoor walking
review_text: On windy days by the lake, the external microphones amplify wind buffeting directly into the ear cups despite wind reduction mode.

title: Great wireless range
review_text: I can leave my laptop in my second-floor home office and walk down to the kitchen without the audio cutting out once.

title: Hinge broke with normal use
review_text: Took it out of the case and the left hinge snapped clean off. Sony claims it is accidental damage and refused warranty coverage.

title: Worth every penny
review_text: Noise cancellation lets me study peacefully in crowded university libraries. Highs and mids are crystal clear.

title: Equalizer presets are great
review_text: Customizing sound profiles for hip hop vs podcasts takes 2 taps in the app. Very versatile headphones.

title: Bose still wins on sheer comfort
review_text: XM5 sounds better than Bose 700, but Bose has deeper ear cavities so your ears never touch the inner grille.

title: 5 stars all the way
review_text: Upgraded from Airpods Max because they were way too heavy. The XM5 is featherlight and ANC is just as capable.

title: Flawless noise cancellation
review_text: Blocks city construction noise outside my apartment window completely. Work from home lifesaver.

title: Decent but not mindblowing
review_text: It does the job, sound is clear, but I expected more given all the hype from YouTube tech reviewers.

title: Cannot use while charging
review_text: Plugging in the USB-C cable immediately powers off the headphones. You cannot listen while charging wired.

title: Top tier acoustics
review_text: Instrumental separation is stunning. Bass response is deep and controlled without bleeding into mids.

title: Case design needs rethink
review_text: It does not collapse flat like the XM4 case. Very bulky for everyday commute.

title: Best noise cancellation on market
review_text: Hands down the best ANC available today. Nothing comes close in train stations or busy streets.

title: Ear pads get warm quickly
review_text: Warm ears within 45 minutes of wearing indoors. Requires taking breaks frequently.

title: Unmatched build and sound
review_text: Matte finish resists fingerprints well. Sound clarity is reference-grade for consumer Bluetooth gear.

title: Multipoint switching is sluggish
review_text: Takes 4-5 seconds to switch audio playback between phone and laptop when an incoming call arrives.

title: A game changer for open plan offices
review_text: Drowns out chatter and mechanical keyboards effortlessly. Increased my productivity significantly.

title: Left channel static noise
review_text: Developed a faint hissing static sound in the left ear cup when ANC is engaged. Returning to BestBuy for replacement.

title: Superior comfort and sound
review_text: Very lightweight, soft padding, rich audio quality. Sony continues to dominate noise cancelling.

title: Battery life as advertised
review_text: Easily gets 30+ hours with ANC on. Fast charge feature saved me before a long train ride.

title: Expensive but worth it
review_text: Premium price tag, but the active noise cancellation quality justifies the cost.

title: Voice pickup on mic is superb
review_text: Clients hear me clearly even when walking outside in downtown traffic. Great for professional remote workers.

title: Headband too narrow
review_text: Concentrates weight right on top of head. Needs wider cushion.

title: Incredible soundstage
review_text: Spacious and detailed audio reproduction. EQ options provide great customization.

title: Auto NC is buggy
review_text: Changes cancellation level abruptly when walking between rooms. Wish I could disable the automatic optimizer.

title: Best Christmas gift
review_text: Got this as a gift from my partner. Could not be happier with the noise suppression and music clarity.

title: Not durable enough for price
review_text: Plastic brackets feel brittle. Handle with extreme care when putting in case.

title: Clear calls, great music
review_text: Does double duty as work headset and audiophile music cans. Seamless experience.

title: Controls unresponsive in cold weather
review_text: Montreal winter temperatures freeze the touch sensor. Frustrating when waiting for bus.

title: Immersive cinema experience
review_text: Watching Dolby Atmos movies on iPad with these headphones is like sitting in an IMAX theater.

title: Great ANC, average mic in heavy wind
review_text: ANC is top class, but mic struggles to reject severe wind noise during outdoor phone calls.

title: Absolute perfection
review_text: Everything I wanted in noise cancelling headphones: comfortable, long battery, rich bass, and sleek design.
